summary: OpenStreetMap maps a lattice observation tower called Stone Lookout Tower; no lookout register lists it, and no source found describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Known only from a map entry; no source confirms that a tower stands there.

evidence.supports: Named Stone Lookout Tower on OpenStreetMap
Most recent edit note calls the structure a communication mast

notes_for_editor: Only record is OSM node 357997533: tags say lattice observation tower, but its latest edit comment says communication mast, so the entry may be wrong about use. Not on NHLR or FFLOS Mississippi lists. The 1949 Maxie Fire Tower (Pastmaps description of a USGS sheet near Wiggins) is not linked to this site by any source; do not merge them without a map check. County not confirmed by any quoted page, so the story says Mississippi only. OSM links GNIS feature 711500; the GNIS page is JavaScript-only and was not read. anyplaceamerica.com returned 403. Pastmaps descriptions look machine-written; check the USGS sheet itself before publishing. Absence checked 2026-10-21: the full NHLR Mississippi list (65 entries, Airey through Yazoo) and the FFLOS Mississippi list (3 entries: Handle, Lee, Troy) contain no Stone entry. The OSM node page shows the communication mast comment on version 3.
